parts.description:
A visual element that tracks the position and size of the active tab. Exposes the active tab
geometry as CSS variables (`--active-tab-{top,right,bottom,left,width,height}`) so it can be
animated with CSS.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs

Groups the individual tab buttons and manages keyboard navigation.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs

inputs.name: activateOnFocus
inputs.description:
Whether a tab is activated when it receives focus (automatic activation).
When `false`, tabs are only activated on click or Enter/Space.

inputs.name: loopFocus
inputs.description: Whether keyboard navigation should loop from the last tab back to the first.

parts.description:
Owns the entire Panel view, including its native host and Angular children. Use `
...
` to remove an inactive panel after its exit finishes. Add `keepMounted: true` to retain it. The value is inherited by rdxTabsPanel.

inputs.name: rdxTabsPanelPresenceKeepMounted
inputs.description: Keep the entire inactive Panel view mounted and hidden.

inputs.name: rdxTabsPanelPresence
inputs.description: The value of the Panel owned by this template.

parts.description:
A panel displayed when its corresponding tab is active.

By default the panel stays in the DOM and is toggled with the `hidden` attribute. To unmount the
entire view while inactive, apply `*rdxTabsPanelPresence="value"` to the Panel host. That
structural owner supplies its value and waits for exit motion before destroying the view.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional native panel id. Defaults to an SSR-stable id unique to this panel instance.

inputs.name: keepMounted
inputs.description:
Retained native Panel option. With structural presence, set `keepMounted` on the structural
template (`*rdxTabsPanelPresence="value; keepMounted: true"`) to retain the whole view.

inputs.name: value

parts.description:
Groups the tabs and the corresponding panels.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description:
The value of the tab that should be initially selected when uncontrolled.
When omitted, Base UI parity uses `0` as the implicit default and falls back to the first enabled tab.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description:
The orientation the tabs are laid out. Controls arrow-key navigation
(left/right vs. up/down).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description:
The controlled selected value. A defined input owns selection until the parent updates it.
Use `(valueChange)` for two-way binding or `(onValueChange)` to decide how to handle requests.

outputs.name: onValueChange
outputs.description:
Event emitted for selection requests and automatic uncontrolled consistency changes.
Controlled requests do not change selection until the parent updates the value input.

`eventDetails.reason` is `'none'` for user-initiated changes, `'initial'` for the first automatic
uncontrolled selection, `'disabled'` when an uncontrolled selection falls back from a disabled tab,
and `'missing'` when it falls back from a removed tab. Automatic changes are not cancelable.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: Accepted value requests and automatic uncontrolled changes. Supports `[(value)]`.

parts.description:
An individual interactive tab button that activates its corresponding panel.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description:
When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the tab.
Disabled tabs remain focusable during composite keyboard navigation, matching Base UI.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional native tab id. Defaults to an SSR-stable id unique to this tab instance.

inputs.name: nativeButton
inputs.description:
Whether the host element is a native button. Native Enter activation stays with the browser.
Set to `false` for other hosts; links keep native Enter navigation and other hosts receive keyboard clicks.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: A unique value that associates the tab with a panel.
